data.text: My family taught me that this lake feeds the village month after month, so I want to protect both it and the families who need treatment. Luke, can you get someone from the clinic to confirm the amount and deadline? I’d support Kate’s 50-ton total catch, with the proceeds paid directly to the clinic, if we can secure the other $10,000 in time. If the full $60,000 really is needed today and there’s no workable alternative, I’ll commit my 15 tons provided we all agree to the 60-ton total this month and 30-ton total next month. John, would you support that plan?
